page.overview:
Who is Blue Snake?

The is a recurring character in . The Blue Snake appears alongside the Red Snake at Vasu Jewelers.

Same as the Red Snake, the Blue Snake's main purpose is to allow Link to transfer all his appraised Magic Rings between linked and game files. With the Blue Snake, this is done with the use of two Game Boy Colors (not Game Boy Advances) and a Game Link Cable. With both games inserted in either Game Boy Color, the Blue Snake must be spoken to in one of the games, while the other remains at the starting screen. If done correctly, when "Link" is selected upon speaking to the Blue Snake, all the rings will transfer to the opposing game.

The link will not work if the two games inserted into the Game Boy Color are the same game (two Ages or two Seasons), or if the two games are not linked.

If a Game Link Cable is not available, the Blue Snake cannot be used to transfer rings. The Red Snake can then be used instead as an alternative.
